findings.source_observation: JsonObject::operator[] stores m_value.find(key) in a function-static iterator. Later Json objects reuse the iterator bound to the first object's map.
findings.native_control: A Qt6 executable built with unchanged pinned orderedjson.cpp reads the first object's value when looking up the same key on a second live object.
findings.impact_boundary: Concrete cross-object lookup contamination; broader GUI/data-loss behavior is not exercised.

findings.source_observation: tryParseOrderedJsonFile assigns OrderedJson::parse(...).object_items() and checks only the error string. Valid array/scalar roots have no parse error and expose an empty object_items() view, so this caller reports success with an empty object.
findings.native_control: The original parser is tested with a valid array root; ParseUtil itself is source-inspected, not executed.

findings.source_observation: Json::fromQJsonValue converts every QJsonValue::Double through toInt(), truncating fractional input.
findings.native_control: The original implementation and Qt6 QJsonValue are compiled and exercised with 1.75.

findings.source_observation: Truncated and trailing input fail with an error; comments require COMMENTS mode; duplicate object keys overwrite the value while the OrderedMap retains first insertion order.
findings.native_control: Compiled original implementation with positive and malformed inputs; exact assertions in the harness.
